summary: Capstone nails A6.13 and revisits D1-D4: estimation, addition, story-problems, sharing all return in the four stations. Walkthrough names the size-vs-value trap (dime smaller than nickel but worth more) with three branching recovery moves anchored to embossed images. 8+22+10=40 min sits at K cap. Closing chant 'Penny ONE, Nickel FIVE, Dime TEN, Quarter TWENTY-FIVE!' is the refrain. Coin Hunt floor variant gives a no-paper, real-coin path. Worksheet Part 3 (compose 10¢ three ways) is a transfer task, not rote repeat.
